headline: Sharp quarterly rebound in sales and profit
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 78.1B (+32.8% y/y) and operating profit KRW 17.7B (+426.4% y/y); EPS was KRW 614, up 267.7% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of KRW 614 rose 411.7% q/q and 267.7% y/y. Preliminary figures put revenue at KRW 78,076M (+30.4% q/q) and operating profit at KRW 17,667M versus KRW 1,423M in Q2. Nine-month revenue is still down 25.4% and operating profit down 72.5% y/y. Guidance is not assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Figures are preliminary, subject to auditor review, and come from StockHub's summary of the DART filing. EPS is Yahoo data.
